exposure: Cesarean birth (CB) scar niche dimensions and position
cohort: The study included 52 pregnant women with one previous cesarean birth after >=8 cm cervical dilatation.
finding: This study demonstrates that 3D cesarean birth scar sonographic features are highly reproducible in pregnant women with a history of advanced labor cesarean birth.
mod_finding: The study's finding on reproducibility specifically applies to pregnant women with a history of advanced labor cesarean birth.
cross-section timing: Ultrasound volumes were acquired between 11 and 24 weeks' gestation.
